主要内容: The Walt Disney Company extended the expiration date of the Exchange Offers for 21CFA Notes from February 6, 2019, to February 19, 2019. The Exchange Offers are conditional on the closing of New Disney’s acquisition of 21CF and other terms. The acquisition is expected to close in the first half of 2019, with potential further extensions. Settlement will occur on or about the date the Acquisition is consummated. If the Acquisition is not consummated, or settlement does not otherwise occur, the 21CFA Notes will be promptly returned to the tendering holders. The text also includes forward-looking statements regarding the consummation of the Acquisition and the anticipated benefits thereof, as well as risks such as regulatory approvals, tax treatment, and potential litigation related to the transaction.
